name: Par2 Protect
description: Creates SHA-256 checksums and PAR2 recovery volumes to protect against bitrot.

name: Smart Sort
description: Automatically organizes files into categorized subfolders by MIME type.

name: Discord Split
description: Splits large files into 24MB parts for Discord uploads and creates auto-join scripts.

name: Media Clean Names
description: Sanitizes release & codec tags from video filenames for Plex/Jellyfin libraries.

name: Csv Split
description: Splits massive CSV files into 100k-row chunks while preserving the header row.

name: Webp Strip Exif
description: Converts images to WebP and strips sensitive EXIF metadata (GPS, camera info).

name: Mp4 Optimize
description: Re-encodes and compresses videos to web-optimized H.264 MP4 format.

name: Fat32 Split
description: Splits files over 3.9GB into sequential parts for FAT32 drive compatibility.

name: Chd Compress
description: Losslessly compresses raw disc images (ISO, BIN/CUE) to CHD format for emulators.
